extracted.name: Berbere (Ethiopian Spice)
extracted.description: This berbere recipe is an Ethiopian spice blend made with fenugreek, paprika, ginger, coriander, and many more spices. It's key to many Ethiopian dishes.
instruction_lines: Combine chili powder, paprika, salt, fenugreek, ginger, onion powder, coriander, cardamom, garlic powder, cloves, and cinnamon in a bowl. Transfer to an airtight container; store in the refrigerator.
